candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule with only anchor_policy and anchor_contract visible, conditionally changes the causal polarity of anchor_policy, and emits exactly one complete executable state. The third consumes only that state with task_constraints and loop_structure, and the final call consumes the resulting closure with task and candidate_hypothesis. Raw trigger evidence and side reports do not propagate beyond the transition.
candidate_structure.name: Anchor Polarity Transition Relay
candidate_structure.organization: four-call sequential executable lineage with one evidence-triggered authority-state transition on the anchor reentry edge

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule and compare its carried commitments with reentered anchor_policy under anchor_contract. When an anchor-contingent obligation is the sole visible support for a carried commitment, reverse anchor_policy from constructive precedent to counterexample-only evidence and revise the same artifact accordingly. Regardless of transition, emit exactly one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_polarity_transition, assess the single inherited executable state against only reentered task_constraints and loop_structure, reconcile visible obligations within its established evidence authority, and emit one complete executable policy closure.

Consume constraint_structure_transition, assess the inherited complete executable closure against only reentered task and candidate_hypothesis, reconcile remaining visible obligations in that same artifact, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion can reconcile anchor evidence but cannot reverse its constructive authority when that evidence is causally nontransferable.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This introduces conditional evidence-polarity control on an existing edge rather than adding a reviewer, certificate, gate, field, role split, rename, or causal re-root.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: Downstream calls receive one executable state in which no commitment is retained solely because of the triggered anchor-contingent support.
mode_certificate.state_transition: anchor_policy changes from constructive-precedent authority to counterexample-only authority while the inherited executable artifact remains the lineage root
mode_certificate.trigger: anchor_contract marks an obligation as anchor-contingent and comparison with anchor_policy shows that obligation is the sole visible support for a commitment carried by the inherited capsule

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Make the anchor reentry edge transition anchor_policy from constructive precedent to counterexample-only evidence when anchor_contract establishes that an inherited commitment depends solely on an anchor-contingent obligation.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The continuously executable lineage can shed nontransferable anchor influence before later evidence windows act while preserving its existing artifact ancestry.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion always treats reentered anchor evidence as constructive precedent, so an anchor-contingent commitment can retain causal authority even when its supporting obligation is nontransferable.

structural_mutation.after: The anchor reentry edge conditionally reverses anchor_policy into counterexample-only evidence when anchor_contract identifies an anchor-contingent obligation as the sole support for a carried commitment; the edge still emits exactly one executable state on the same lineage.
structural_mutation.before: The anchor reentry edge always grants anchor_policy constructive reconciliation authority over the inherited executable capsule.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes the causal authority and state-transition semantics of a concrete edge without adding a call, side artifact, or alternate lineage.
